subject: afi-2
title: AFI.(2)--------STY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 394 (JR-16). AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) is the subject; STY (style) is the partner. The title names AFI-(2); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis), TRS (transition) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From CULT-AF-B: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From TRS: INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From T-C-IMP: MT-INFO (multi-information). From AF-DY: OP-SD (option spread). From MT-INFO: VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From VT-PLT: PART (participation).
